description: Scans a URL / host for SSRF and egress-policy violations before an outbound request or browser navigation — cloud instance-metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254), private/loopback/link-local targets, decimal/octal/hex IP obfuscation, denied schemes (file:, gopher:), credentials-in-URL, punycode/homograph hosts, and allow/deny-list + port policy. Deterministic and offline by default; optional DNS resolution detects DNS-rebinding when resolve=true. Returns PASS/FLAG/BLOCK with findings. Call before an agent fetches a URL.

allowHosts.description: If set, host must be in this allowlist.

allowedPorts.description: If set, only these explicit ports are allowed.

blockSeverityAtOrAbove.description: Minimum severity that yields BLOCK (default: high).

resolve.description: Resolve DNS and flag rebinding to private/metadata IPs (default false; the only networked option).

name: scan_url
